arxiv-2307-08823.description: Abstract Companies like OpenAI, Google DeepMind, and Anthropic have the stated goal of building artificial general intelligence (AGI) – AI systems that perform as well as or better than humans on a wide variety of cognitive tasks. However, there are increasing concerns that AGI would pose catastrophic risks.

arxiv-2504-08251.title: General Theory of Coupled Characteristic Mode: An Eigen Subspace Approach
arxiv-2504-08251.creator: Rakesh Sinha, Sandip Ghosal
arxiv-2504-08251.description: Abstract In this work, the problem of characteristic mode analysis using eigendecomposition of the method of moments impedance matrix has been simplified using the eigen-subspace approach. The idea behind the eigen-subspace arises from the physical properties of antenna or scatterers, where only a few eigenmodes are enough to characterize the antenna or scatterer.

arxiv-2504-17718.title: Recursive feasibility for stochastic MPC and the rationale behind fixing flat tires
arxiv-2504-17718.creator: Mirko Fiacchini, Martina Mammarella, Fabrizio Dabbene
arxiv-2504-17718.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mirko Fiacchini, Martina Mammarella, Fabrizio Dabbene. In this paper, we address the problem of designing stochastic model predictive control (SMPC) schemes for linear systems affected by unbounded disturbances. The contribution of the paper is rooted in a measured-state initialization strategy. First, due to the nonzero probability of violating chance-constraints in the case of unbounded noise, we introduce ellipsoidal-based probabilistic reachable sets and we include constraint relaxations to recover recursive feasibility conditioned to the measured state.

arxiv-2505-12882.title: PhyDA: Physics-Guided Diffusion Models for Data Assimilation in Atmospheric Systems
arxiv-2505-12882.creator: Hao Wang, Jindong Han, Wei Fan, Weijia Zhang, Hao Liu
arxiv-2505-12882.description: Abstract Data Assimilation (DA) plays a critical role in atmospheric science by reconstructing spatially continous estimates of the system state, which serves as initial conditions for scientific analysis. While recent advances in diffusion models have shown great potential for DA tasks, most existing approaches remain purely data-driven and often overlook the physical laws that govern complex atmospheric dynamics.

pmc-13025371.title: Emerging Sustainable Bioprocess for the Valorization of Agave Bagasse for Single-Cell Protein Production
pmc-13025371.creator: Emiro Leal-Urbina, Elisa Dufoo-Hurtado, Marcela Gaytán-Martínez, Edgar N. Tec-Caamal, Aurea K. Ramírez-Jiménez
pmc-13025371.description: In this work, a food-compatible bioprocess was evaluated for the production of yeast single-cell protein from mezcal agave bagasse. Bagasse was enzymatically hydrolyzed at 10% (w/v) solids (pH 4.8, 50 °C, 24 h) using commercial enzymes. The resulting liquid was clarified by activated charcoal adsorption and filtration to obtain a hydrolysate suitable for submerged fermentation.

pmc-13094436.creator: F. Kemik, T.K. Şahin, H. Özçelik, A. Sezer, G. Başaran, S.D. Açıkel Yüksel, G. Güney, İ. Yıldız, Ö. Er, T. Korkmaz, S. Biter, D. Erdem, S. Tünbekici, A. Oruç, A.K. Güren, K. Kaban, M.B. Aykan, Ö.B. Ekinci, İ. Deliktaş Onur, A. Kalem, O. Altunok, M. Seyyar, B. Güney, O. Akdoğan, M. Yazıcı, N. Majidov
pmc-13094436.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundOptimal sequencing of trastuzumab emtansine (T-DM1) and trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) in HER2 positive metastatic breast cancer (mBC) remains uncertain, and real-world evidence on the impact of prior T-DM1 exposure on subsequent T-DXd outcomes is limited.MethodsWe conducted a multicenter, retrospective cohort study across 21 oncology centers in Türkiye including consecutive adults with HER2 positive mBC who received at least one cycle of T-DXd between 2020 and 2025. Patients were classified as T-DM1 pretreated or T-DM1 naive at T-DXd initiation.

pmc-13139052.title: The Role of Piezo 1 in the Study of Intervertebral Disc Degeneration: Phenotype, Mechanism and Treatment
pmc-13139052.creator: Guangye Li, Chaoqun Feng, Haoyun Huang, Junwen Deng, Fei Yang, Rigao Chen
pmc-13139052.description: BackgroundIntervertebral disc degeneration (IVDD), a prevalent spinal disorder, is closely associated with abnormal mechanical stress. The nucleus pulposus (NP), annulus fibrosus (AF), and cartilaginous endplate (CEP) collectively respond to mechanical loading. The mechanosensitive Piezo 1 ion channel senses mechanical stress changes and converts the mechanical signals into chemical signals, and serves a pivotal role in IVDD pathogenesis.

pmc-13195656.title: Leveraging Mechanistic Insights into Stereoretentive ROMP for Precision Synthesis of Poly(p‑phenylene vinylene)s
pmc-13195656.creator: Jake L. Nicholson, Samuel J. Kempel, Ángel Rentería-Gómez, Ting-Wei Hsu, Antoine C. Gravet, Caroline E. Gallo, Osvaldo Gutierrez, Quentin Michaudel
pmc-13195656.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Poly­(p-phenylene vinylene) (PPV) is an important class of conjugated polymers whose properties are largely dictated by structural parameters such as backbone regioregularity, defect content, alkene geometry, side-chain structure, and the sequence of repeat units. Despite decades of development and applications spanning optoelectronic devices to biomedical imaging, a controlled, defect-free polymerization method that affords predictable command over all structural attributes of PPVs has remained elusive.

pmc-13239233.title: Living Donor Intestinal Transplant: Indication, Techniques, Surgical Complications, and Outcomes in Recipients and Donors: A Systematic Review
pmc-13239233.creator: Adil Nusair, Saad Bin Yousuf, Ahmed Adham R Elsayed, Marc D Basson, Richa Sharma
pmc-13239233.description: BackgroundLiving donor intestinal transplantation (LDITx) is an alternative option to cadaveric transplants as a last resort in treating intestinal failure. There are limited data on LDITx outcomes. This systematic review evaluates LDITx in terms of indications, contraindications, surgical complications, and patient outcomes.

pmc-13290333.title: Early-life thermal stress and mid-growth light intensity as key environmental predictors of lameness in commercial Cobb 500 broilers under tropical closed-house production systems
pmc-13290333.creator: Parita Noisamran, Wiriya Loongyai, Choawit Rakangthong, Chaiyapoom Bunchasak
pmc-13290333.description: Background and Aim:Lameness is a major welfare and economic concern in fast-growing broiler chickens, particularly under tropical intensive production systems where environmental stressors are pronounced. Despite its multifactorial etiology, large-scale field evidence quantifying the combined effects of housing microclimate on lameness in Southeast Asian closed-house systems remains limited.

pmc-13352501.title: Inpatient Hemato-Oncology Service Use Before, During, and After COVID-19 Restrictions in a Romanian Tertiary Center
pmc-13352501.creator: Paul C Toboltoc
pmc-13352501.description: IntroductionThe coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic disrupted cancer diagnosis and treatment pathways, but hospital-based evidence on inpatient hemato-oncology service use in Eastern Europe remains limited. This study evaluated how the pandemic period affected case capture, diagnostic confirmation, repeated inpatient representation, hospital admissions, and hospital days among adults with lymphoma, leukemia, or multiple myeloma treated in a Romanian tertiary center.
